name: A Threat in Feralas
summary: Belgrom Rockmaul sends you to Camp Mojache to speak with Rok Orhan about the growing Gordunni ogre tribe. Their strength threatens your side's presence in Feralas.

sections.title: A Growing Force
sections.body: The Gordunni ogres are Feralas's dominant military force, and their numbers are increasing. Belgrom Rockmaul sends you to Camp Mojache to find Rok Orhan, a warrior who can tell you more about the situation.

faq.answer: Belgrom Rockmaul sends you to speak with Rok Orhan about the Gordunni in Feralas.
Rok Orhan is a warrior who resides at Camp Mojache in Feralas and can tell you more about the Gordunni situation.
The Gordunni are an ogre tribe and Feralas's dominant military force. Their numbers are growing.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Camp Mojache?
faq.answer: Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache, where she can explain more about the situation.

angles.text: As a warrior, you are called to prove yourself against the growing Gordunni threat in Feralas.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Threat in Feralas
